name: cursor-spider-coach
description: Sends real Cursor coding events to the Spider Coach desktop companion.

cursorSpiderCoach.detectComposerDrafts.description: Detect typing in the Composer input before Send (read-only local Cursor DB). Build after ~12 chars or ~2.5s composing in one burst. Requires sqlite3.

cursorSpiderCoach.detectComposerPrompts.description: Detect when a Composer message is sent (saved user bubble). Requires sqlite3.

cursorSpiderCoach.detectAgentRunning.description: Detect when the Cursor agent starts working (generating, reading files). Shows running state 2–8s after work starts, 1 min gap between shows. Requires sqlite3.

cursorSpiderCoach.keepOverlayVisibleInDe.description: When the Electron dev app is running (ELECTRON_DEV), do not hide the spider overlay when Cursor loses focus. Use with the dev panel “Pin spider visible” toggle.
